🔌 REI Skills Smart MCP Server (rei-skills-mcp / npx rei-skills mcp)
Zero-Dependency Stdio JSON-RPC 2.0

Connect your AI assistant directly to the REI Skills Smart MCP Server. Instead of loading all 1436 skills into your prompt, your AI agent can dynamically call rei_recommend_skills, rei_search_skills, rei_get_skill, rei_get_workflow, rei_install_skill, and rei_compile_skill on demand! 

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "rei-skills": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "rei-skills", "mcp"]
    },
    "rei-rea": {
      "command": "rei-rea",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
1. rei_recommend_skills

Smart Intent & Stack Router: analyzes natural language tasks (EN/TR) and workspace filenames (.wasm, .apk, .tsx, Dockerfile) to return top-ranked skills, workflows, and execution plans.

2. rei_get_skill

Loads the complete SKILL.md instructions and reference files (e.g. references/workflow.md) for any skill ID on demand without bloating context.

3. rei_install_skill & rei_compile_skill

Installs or transpiles skills on the fly into any of the 21 supported AI assistant formats (cursor-mdc, copilot-instructions, windsurf-rule, sdk-json).

Research Writing & Independent Skill Evaluation

Google Research PaperOrchestra
Opt-in research writing

The rei-paper-orchestra skill coordinates a separately installed, upstream multi-agent pipeline for evidence-led literature synthesis, manuscript sections, optional plots and LaTeX output. No external processing runs without explicit consent. AI-generated citations and experimental claims require independent review.

Skill instructions · Integration guide

NVIDIA SkillEvaluator
Independent Tier 1 checks

Optional NVIDIA SkillEvaluator v0.9.0 runs separately from the npm package. GitHub Actions provides scoped Tier 1 checks in advisory mode; a green workflow does not certify all skills, full security, or Tier 2/3 model-based evaluation.
